properties.name: A premise says whether it rests on its owner's intent or on its delivery; a design choice's step reads its needs as intent by default
properties.rationale: Anthony's ruling, 2026-10-24 (dec:a-premise-says-whether-it-rests-on-intent-or-delivery), from the root cause fact:root-cause-a-design-choice-read-its-requirements-by-delivery-because-the-premise-truth-reused-the-delivery-line-2026-10-24 (the class of 2026-09-29's closure finding: a verdict defined for delivery reused for a design choice's grounds). The cause corrected: a premise's truth answered only "is it delivered?" for a requirement, capability or interface, so a choice resting on accepted intent could never read supported before it was built; the Shop sample's 19 chains all read unknown. The served capture-intent text had promised an accepted requirement was checkable (a42269d89) while the code read delivery; it now says what is read. Guard against recurrence: crates/reflow2-core/tests/a_premise_says_whether_it_rests_on_intent_or_delivery.rs, 11 class tests, 8 of the first 10 observed failing on main 61c05ad74 (an accepted requirement read "not delivered", an interface "computes no truth", a capability "not both realized and checked", no marker read back), and a golden of the 17 proof, argument and verification trial fixtures' readings taken on 61c05ad74, which still match; plus 2 MCP wire tests. Not changed: an accepted Decision premise still counts as uncited (outside the ruling). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: PREMISE_OF gains `reads_as` (intent | delivery), written per premise by add_inference's `as_intent` and `as_delivery`. Unmarked, a premise of a step concluding a Decision reads as intent; every other step reads delivery. As intent a Requirement reads by status (accepted or met holds, proposed or deferred unknown, dropped fails), a Capability by the needs it SATISFIES, an Interface by its governing Decisions; the Decision the step concludes lends nothing (circular). Statements and every other type read as themselves. step_reading, foundations, reasoning_report (held_on_the_owners_word, awaiting_the_owners_word, never uncited; a held need is not unsupported) and loop_status (the same counts; "WHAT AWAITS THE OWNER'S WORD") agree. capture-intent and add_inference's description now say what is true, and how a computed result enters a chain (a passing computed check whose location names its kept record, never the record as a premise). Toolsnap: add_inference.
